course_outline_concepts: AgentInstruct / AgentTuning / Lumos / FireAct / AutoAct / AgentFlan — design space of agent SFT
SWE-RL (Meta 2025): rule-based reward (difflib ratio) for scalable agent RL
Kimi-K2 agentic: what a frontier lab actually does for long-horizon post-training

sources.what_to_extract: Four-stage agentic flow (Content Transformation → Seed Instruction → Refinement → Answer+Validation); 43-generator suite for reading-comprehension; 25M pair output across 17 skills; GPT-4 teacher; ~$500K API budget.
1,866-trajectory corpus across 6 envs (ALFWorld / WebShop / Mind2Web / KG / OS-bash / SQL); 1:10 AgentInstruct:ShareGPT mixing-ratio sweet spot; AgentLM-70B 4.02 vs Llama-2-Chat 1.58 on AgentBench.

Plan/Ground/Execute three-module decomposition; unified action grammar (Search/Retrieve/Calculate/Click/Type/Back/Finish); Lumos-I vs Lumos-O; 40K tasks → 200K module-level pairs; cross-task generalization drop of ~8 pts vs ~20 for monolithic ReAct.
Method-diversity result: CoT+ReAct+Reflexion mix beats any single method; 40.0% HotpotQA vs 38.9 / 37.3 / 35.2; ~2K trajectories total; method-specific system prompts at inference.
Self-differentiation loop: one base model plays Plan / Tool / Reflect roles via LoRA; zero human or GPT-4 labels; self-consistency filter; ~10K self-generated trajectories; saturates by iteration 4.

Three-capability decomposition (instruction-follow / agent-reason / generalization); four hallucination-correction negative modes (format / action / parameter / relevance); format-alignment with Llama-2 pretraining distribution; 5× halluc-call reduction vs AgentTuning.

Self-hosted Docker env with 5 apps (GitLab/Reddit/Shopping/OSM/Calendar); 812-task benchmark; predicate-based success (URL / page-state / DOM); accessibility-tree vs screenshot observation modes; action vocab (click/type/hover/press/scroll/goto/go_back/stop).

2,438 executable Python tasks across 11 repos; Docker-packaged with hidden pytest suite; OpenHands scaffold rollouts; Qwen-2.5-Coder-7B 3.0→15.3→20.3% on SWE-Bench Verified; 32B reaches 32.0%; verifier best-of-N adds +5 pts.

difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio() rule-based reward against human PR diff; 11M issue-PR triples; GRPO with G=8 β=0.02 LR=1e-6; Llama3-SWE-RL-70B 41.0% SWE-Bench Verified; out-of-domain transfer to MATH/HumanEval+/BBH.

Unified action abstraction (str_replace_editor / execute_bash / execute_ipython_cell / browse / think / finish); sandboxed Docker runtime; cross-domain (SWE / web / data-science); OpenHands-LM-32B 37.2% SWE-Bench Verified; trajectory format (ChatML with tool_calls + tool role).

~1T-token agentic PRETRAINING mix (not just SFT); synthetic environment simulator; 5-role sub-agent orchestration (user/planner/executor/critic/...); critic-LLM filtering; mixed at ~3–5% of pretrain budget; K2 SWE-Bench Verified ~65%.
20,000+ tool library; joint RL stage combining RLVR verifiable reward + self-critique rubric reward; MuonClip optimizer context; 1T-MoE 32B-activated; 15.5T pretraining tokens.
Terminal-Bench 2.0 full trajectory traces; tens of thousands of trials over shared CLI task set; benchmark-as-trajectory-corpus design.
94K successful multimodal web trajectories, 49K unique URLs; exploration-then-refinement decoupling for intent diversity; trajectory-level supervision not final-answer only.
Prepare → Generate → Filter three-stage template as the canonical content-grounded template; faithfulness-filter lineage reused in agent-trajectory filters.
